name: dumbbell glute bridge chest press
description: A dumbbell chest press done lying in a glute bridge. It works the chest and triceps while the glutes hold your hips up.
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.
